harper: Heads-up: canary for billing-service chart v3.1.0 failed in us-west-2 during post-upgrade hook. MountVolume error for namespace billing secret `stripe-creds` :confused:
deploy-bot: canary failure detected: billing-service v3.1.0 -> post-upgrade hook: secret not found
li: it looks like the regional secret-sync job retried and then timed out. preflight passed because it only validates chart values schema, not secret presence.
zack: quick options:
- rollback us-west-2 to v3.0.9 (safe but migration in 3.1.0 is minor index update)
- create secret from vault in-cluster and re-run canary (fast)
- apply a values override with literal apiKey (ugly, avoid if possible)
harper: product wants to avoid rollback unless migrations break. we prefer in-cluster secret creation if vault copy exists.
release-manager: holding promotions to us-* and ca-* until we resolve. applying manual hold now.
oncall: do we have vault copy for us-west-2?
li: yes we have vault secret at secret/billing/us-west/stripe.
zack: ops, can you push a one-off secret and restart? command I would run:
```
VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault kv get -field=apiKey secret/billing/us-west/stripe | \n  kubectl -n billing create secret generic stripe-creds --from-literal=apiKey=$(cat -) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n billing rollout restart deploy/billing-service
```
ops: running the secret apply and restart now.
ops: secret created, pods restarting; mounts look healthy in logs.
deploy-bot: promotion paused by release-manager at 1777770025
ops: re-triggering canary probes.
deploy-bot: canary health checks passed for us-west-2 billing-service v3.1.0 :white_check_mark:
harper: ok to resume promotions but keep 15m stagger between regions and monitor `hook_failure_rate` and `mount_errors` metric.
release-manager: agreed. add release-note: "us-west-2 required manual secret-sync during rollout" under Known Issues.
li: filing follow-ups: GH #4720 -> preflight secret-exists check for values.secretRef; GH #4721 -> console alert when secretRef unresolved; GH #4722 -> rollout checklist update (vault verification step).
zack: also pin edgezone pipeline to v3.1.0 for the next 24h to avoid version drift across tenants.
oncall: note for oncall: if next canary fails with secret mount error, prefer manual secret sync+recheck over rollback unless DB/index migrations fail.
harper: can we add a short circuit preflight in the deploy pipeline this week? small script: check if any values reference secretRef and whether k8s secret exists in target cluster(s).
li: I'll draft the script and open a PR. including toggle to skip for emergency fast-tracks.
release-manager: hold removed at 1777770275. closing thread and tracking GH issues and checklist updates. :white_check_mark:
